source.title: The Prize Within
source.description: Power radiates from inside the box. This must be the artifact! Now you just need to get it open...
source.objective:
Find a way to open the box and claim the artifact, then deliver it to Dietrich Praice in Orgrimmar.

Provided item:
source.completion:
So the story was true... I will hold on to this and investigate its potential. Not only our are enemies deprived of this weapon, but in our own hands it could prove a powerful defense against the Scourge.

Take this, <name>, with my thanks.
